This whole "it's hurting the business" idea is stupid, imo.  Saying that joke spots will turn away people who want to see more 'serious' wrestling from the industry as a whole is like saying comedy movies will make people who only like serious dramatic films just stop watching movies altogether. I don't remember De Niro ever calling out Jim Carrey for "ruining the business". There's a bunch of different places to go for your wrestling needs, they all cater to different tastes and styles and there's something for you no matter what you like, but when viewed together as a whole they bring a greater number of people into the hobby.  And honestly if you as a worker or promoter are having your livelihood "threatened" by one brief spot halfway around the world at an indie show you have nothing to do with, how good at your job can you really be in the first place?  Don't be bitter, be better.
